vc_checking.summary: The initialization and return witnesses are semantically provable with the existing xizi_sll/xizi_sllseg library. The loop-step entailment is not semantically provable as generated: its precondition knows length = Zlength(l1_2) and l = l1_2 ++ (tmp_list :: l0), but no longer carries the public Zlength(l) <= UINT_MAX bound. Therefore it cannot establish unsigned_last_nbits(length + 1, 32) = Zlength(l1_2 ++ [tmp_list]); modular wraparound is possible. This is an invariant/annotation omission and requires regeneration before vc-proving.
